Plugin.Name: Thunderbolt Net
Plugin.Overview: Single-link host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt 3/4/5 and USB4 / USB4 v2 (20G, 40G, and 80G-class hosts) wherever Linux exposes thunderbolt_net. Fabric overview, trained rate and lanes, tbn0/tbn1… settings, services on TB IPs, known peers, harden, activity. One cable, one peer, eth-like UX — not dual-cable bonding or a promise of full sticker dual-lane TCP.
